title: A Neyman-Pearson Approach to Statistical Learning

anchors.quote: Cannon et al. propose the classifier
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 论文从类条件误报率与漏报率出发，把经验漏报最小化置于经验误报上界约束之下，并进一步用随样本量和模型复杂度变化的容差构造 NP-ERM 与 NP-SRM。

EXPERIMENTS.pages: 9-11 numerical bound comparisons and Figure 1; no benchmark learning experiment is reported

anchors.paraphrase_zh: 经验部分是对理论容差和所需样本量的数值代入，而不是在真实数据集上训练并比较分类器；因此它只验证界的数量级示例。

ABLATIONS.pages: 1-30 including theorem comparisons, conclusion, proofs, and implementation appendices
ABLATIONS.absence_reason_zh: 全文比较了不同理论界和不同分类器层级，但没有在固定数据、固定算法与固定随机性下做组件移除、超参数敏感性或选择策略消融；数值例子不能冒充消融实验。

anchors.quote: Unfortunately the computational complexity has an exponential dependence on d.
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 作者明确指出一般 dyadic decision tree 实现对维度呈指数依赖，计算和内存约束把适用范围限制在很低维度。

formulas: The Neyman-Pearson target minimizes class-1 miss risk R1(h) subject to class-0 false-alarm risk R0(h) <= alpha.
NP-ERM minimizes empirical R1 over H subject to empirical R0 <= alpha + epsilon0/2.
The VC tolerance is epsilon_j(n_j, delta_j, H) = sqrt(128(V log n_j + log(8/delta_j))/n_j).
NP-SRM selects among class-specific NP-ERM candidates by empirical miss risk plus a complexity penalty epsilon1/2.
The oracle inequality separately bounds excess false alarm and miss risk with probability at least 1-(delta0+delta1).
algorithm_steps: Split the IID labeled sample by class and compute empirical class-conditional false-alarm and miss risks.
For every permitted classifier class H_k, solve NP-ERM under the sample-size-dependent empirical false-alarm constraint.
Select the class-specific candidate minimizing empirical miss risk plus the prescribed complexity penalty.
For histograms or dyadic decision trees, use the recursive dynamic-programming procedures in Figures 3-5 to obtain the exact constrained empirical-risk solution.
variables: R0 and R1: population false-alarm and miss probabilities
Rhat0 and Rhat1: class-conditional empirical risks
n0 and n1: observed class-specific sample counts
epsilon0 and epsilon1: sample-size and complexity dependent tolerances
H_k, V_k, K(n), and L: classifier hierarchy, VC complexity, maximum class index, and tree depth
selection_timing: Classifier selection occurs once after the complete labeled training sample is available: first within each H_k under the false-alarm constraint, then across classes by structural-risk penalization. This is not online replay-sample selection.
refresh_rule: There is no epoch-wise sample refresh. A new classifier would be recomputed only when the labeled sample, confidence parameters, false-alarm level, or classifier hierarchy changes.

budget.unit: class-conditional labeled observations used to estimate R0 and R1
budget.denominator: the full IID training sample n, with realized class counts n0 and n1
budget.unique_sample_definition: Each IID labeled observation is one training identity; the paper does not define a replay pool or a cross-epoch union of selected IDs.
budget.repeat_definition: No replay repetition is specified; the same finite sample is used by empirical-risk optimization and complexity selection.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: Optimizer-visible cumulative example exposure is not reported because the analyzed estimators are defined as constrained empirical-risk solutions rather than an epoch ledger.
budget.compute_cost: Histogram NP-ERM is O(k^d l0); the general dyadic-tree algorithm is O(n^2 n0 d^2 L^(d+1) log(n L^d)), while the cyclic alternative is O(n0 n^2 d^2 L^2).

random_baselines: No global-random or method-matched-random sample-selection baseline is evaluated.
The paper explicitly omits randomized Neyman-Pearson tests and analyzes non-randomized classifiers.
The main comparison is between older and tighter probability bounds, not between paired stochastic training interventions.
datasets: No empirical benchmark dataset is trained; the paper uses an abstract IID binary-classification distribution and numerical examples for finite or VC classes.
checkpoint_selection: There is no iterative neural-network checkpoint. The estimator is the exact or theoretical constrained empirical-risk solution; no validation-selected or test-selected training endpoint is studied.

results.claim: 一般 dyadic decision tree 的精确实现存在明显高维计算失败条件。
results.value: The implementation is stated to be limited by computation and memory to d < 15; a cyclic-tree restriction reduces the polynomial factors and removes L^(d+1).

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 该限制使原算法不能直接作为高维视觉模型回流选择器，最多能提供局部风险约束的统计机制。

ablations: The paper reports no component-removal or matched-budget empirical ablation; theorem-bound comparisons and numerical substitutions are not counted as ablations.
negative_results: NP-ERM over a fixed classifier class cannot approximate many optimal rules and is not universally consistent.
The paper derives no oracle inequality for false-alarm error analogous to the miss-risk oracle inequality.
The general dyadic-tree implementation has exponential dependence on dimension and is impractical beyond low-dimensional settings.
Practical effects on boosting, support-vector machines, and real asymmetric-error applications are explicitly left for future work.
failure_conditions: Class-conditional sample counts are too small for the selected confidence tolerance.
The classifier hierarchy cannot approximate the constrained Bayes rule.
The operational false-alarm target is chosen after inspecting test outcomes rather than fixed independently.
High-dimensional features make the exact tree implementation computationally infeasible.
A high-probability population bound is mistaken for evidence that a replay-selected sample set causes utility.
limitations: The contribution is predominantly theoretical and lacks a real benchmark training comparison.
Randomized tests are not treated explicitly.
No training seed, order, checkpoint, random selection, or no-replay comparison is reported.
The method controls class-conditional false alarm and miss risk, but does not define the Stage1 FN=0..95 raw safety-frontier normalized AUC.
The exact dyadic-tree solver scales poorly with feature dimension.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文可迁移的是目标与数据角色合同：先在独立且预先冻结的操作/校准数据上定义一端错误约束，再优化另一端错误，并把有限样本容差和多模型选择复杂度显式计入。它支持把 FN95 视为局部约束目标而非任意总分，也提醒训练、校准和测试必须分离。
stage1_non_inference_zh: 该文没有选择回流样本、没有固定 replay slots 与累计 optimizer-visible exposure、没有 R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 配对干预，也没有跨训练种子的 FN95 结果。因此 NP 风险界和数值样本量例子不能证明任何 Q/R/A/D 候选集合具有 Stage1 utility，更不能把 pAUC 或 NP 约束本身当作 utility evidence。
exclusion_reason: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON:eligible as a target-risk and inference-control mechanism paper
